text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Glory day for Tunisian soccer squad who beat Liberia 2-0 in their World Cup qualifying match played on Sunday in Tunis.
- Mahdia, Tunisia's central region, accomodated 103,835 tourists in 1996.
- Tunisia, Spain set up scientific cooperation for fishing in northern Tunisia.
- Arab and African publishers discussed in Tunis communications technologies.
- Lebanese Foreign Affairs Minister Faris Bouez arrived in Tunis on Sunday on a three-day visit for talks with Tunisian officials.
- President Ben Ali congratulated the Tunisian soccer team for his success against Liberia.
- Tunisia and Qatar plan to create a joint firm to package Tunisian olive oil in Qatar.
